title: Portable clean-project foundation prepared and verified
summary: Prepared the standalone DVendo Supply foundation with editable synthetic UI sources and embedded licensed fonts, a Worker API limited to health/capabilities, OpenAPI, product/architecture/data/deployment guides, 33 historical DITO endpoints, a source/hash import manifest, selected evidence and a portable findings recorder. Twenty-one API, synthetic planning-model and project tests passed. An independent source copy outside the old checkout rebuilt, tested and verified without installed dependencies or parent-project imports. The development server returned HTTP 200 for the preview and health route in a local smoke test. Cloudflare staging dry-run bundling passed; runtime type generation passed outside the sandbox after a local-socket permission failure. Wrangler 4.152.0 with Undici 7.30.1 override audited with zero reported vulnerabilities after earlier toolchain audits reported issues. These are local/offline/build observations, not live DITO verification. Authentication, persistent plans, wallet debit, recipient fulfillment and scheduling remain unimplemented. No remote repository or deployment was created.

evidence.description: Project entrypoint, capability status and guide index.
Source identity and original/imported SHA-256 provenance.
Pinned development toolchain, including patched HTTP dependency.

evidence.location: Independent-copy and local HTTP verification on 2026-10-26
evidence.description: Build, 21 offline tests, documentation/provenance validation and HTTP availability passed without DITO requests.

nextSteps: Move the project contents into a fresh repository after the owner chooses its name and visibility.
Implement authenticated scoped application records before connecting the preview to real data.
Separately verify supplier-wallet-funded recipient fulfillment before enabling purchases or renewal automation.
